title: Visions and Challenges in Managing and Preserving Data to Measure Quality of Life
reasoning: The paper includes a dedicated section "2.2. Privacy, Security and Ethical Challenges" and discusses "2.3. Individual, Community and Societal Values". It addresses ethical approvals for health data research, privacy concerns, the concept of "human data bleeding", and the importance of trust and transparency for societal value in health data management. GDPR is also mentioned as a relevant regulation.
